## 席位核对 · Amendment · 2026-11-15T16:17Z · claim 6897452024 file surface widened

Branch unchanged: `claude/project-thread-iy541q`.

File surface (adds to the claimed one): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewHeaderChrome.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx`, and their tests (`ObjectView.headerFold-12705.test.tsx` and a new pin file if needed). No open PR touches these files (read 16:17Z).

Why: the card thread read on `origin/main` `bc6b7ffd` that the PageHeader fold (objectui#12705) works as designed. The defect is upstream of it: `foldedHeaderActions` keeps a labelled action only when one is declared primary, so a list with no New and no `variant: 'primary'` action folds to a bare "…". The seat accepts the route "no declared primary ⇒ no folded face", which leaves the PageHeader policy and its #12705 pins unchanged. `ObjectDataPage.tsx` has the same shape (it folds to only a "…" when the reader cannot create), so it is in scope and changes in the same PR.

Pins the seat expects: no New + an undeclared toolbar action + a long description at ~1440 px ⇒ the action stays a labelled button and `data-folded` is absent; CONTROL: a declared primary still folds at 600 px as today. Name in the report what a no-primary header does between phone width and desktop width (it no longer folds there).
